title: Bap Co. Pack
description: Essential optimization mods, visual tweaks, quality of life improvements, inventory management and utmost customization.
body:
The Bap Co. Pack is a lightweight Minecraft modpack designed to improve visuals, optimization, and quality-of-life without altering core gameplay. It aims to deliver a smoother, more visually pleasing, and more customizable experience while remaining fully compatible with vanilla survival and multiplayer.

This pack includes a curated selection of performance enhancements that reduce lag and remove annoyances. For visuals, a series of mods create a more immersive experience while maintaining strong performance. Optional shader support is available through Iris. Quality-of-life improvements include convenience mods, inventory management, and building utilities that help a lot with technical building and large-scale survival projects.

The pack also enhances player information control with BetterF3, Resourcify, Searchables, and CraftPresence, and includes libraries like Architectury, Balm, Cloth Config, MaLiLib, and several APIs required by included mods. Simple Voice Chat is included for communication, and ViaFabric ensures compatibility with servers across different versions.
